run_rotational_friction_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a rotating cube and sphere to demonstrate rotational friction
load_urdf_cube_and_sphere: load a URDF cube and sphere into a pybullet physics simulation with maximal coordinates enabled
set_joint_velocity_control: set a joint motor to velocity control mode with a target velocity and force on a loaded URDF body
configure_simulation_gravity: configure the simulation gravity vector and step the physics loop at a fixed timestep
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to the pybullet GUI renderer and set additional search paths for URDF data assets
